summary: Steve Odin is a scholar of philosophy and Japanology who studied under David A. Dilworth and Edward S. Casey at Stony Brook University (~1975–1980). In 1982, he became Professor of Philosophy at the University of Hawaii.

Steven Collins was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology who completed his D.Phil. at Oxford (~1974–1979) under Richard Gombrich. He taught at the University of Bristol (~1980–1991) and the University of Chicago (from 1991).

Steven Edward Lindquist is a scholar of Indology and religious studies. He earned his Ph.D. under Patrick Olivelle at the University of Texas at Austin in 2005 and held a post at Concordia University.

Steven Heine works in Buddhist studies, Japanology, and religious studies. Educated at Temple University (~1972–1980) and the University of Pennsylvania, he taught at Penn State (~1991–1997) before becoming Professor at Florida International University (~1997).

Steven Lukes is a philosopher and sociologist who studied at Balliol and Nuffield Colleges, Oxford. He served as Fellow and Tutor at Balliol (~1966–1987) and held positions at the EUI, Siena, LSE, and NYU.
Steven Neal Weinberger specializes in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He earned his MA (1991) and PhD (2003) under Jeffrey Hopkins at the University of Virginia, where he was attested in 2006.

Sthaneshwar Timalsina is a scholar of Indology, philosophy, and religious studies. He studied at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University and Halle-Wittenberg, and held posts at Nepal Sanskrit University, San Diego State University (~2005–2022), and Stony Brook (~2022).

Stig Wikander was an Indologist and linguist who studied at Uppsala and Copenhagen under H. S. Nyberg and Arthur Christensen. He taught at Lund University (1941–1953) and was professor of Sanskrit at Uppsala (~1953–1974).
Stuart McFarlane is a scholar of religious studies, Sinology, and Buddhist studies who held a post in the Department of Religious Studies at Lancaster University (attested 1991, 2001).
Stuart Ray Sarbacker specializes in religious studies, Indology, and philosophy. He earned his Ph.D. in 2001 at the University of Wisconsin-Madison under the supervision of David M. Knipe.

Su Bai was a specialist in Buddhist studies, Sinology, and archaeology. He studied at Peking University (~1940–1944), where he later served as Professor and Professor Emeritus in the Archaeology Department (~1988–2018).

Subhadradis Diskul was a historian and archaeologist in Buddhist studies who studied at the École du Louvre (~1948–1953). He served as President of the Siam Society (~1982–1986) and Chairman of the Jim Thompson Foundation.

Subhash Kak works in Indology and history/archaeology. After studies at NIT Srinagar and IIT Delhi, he held posts at JNU (~1971–1979), Imperial College London (~1975–1976), and Louisiana State University (attested 2005–2008).
Sudhir Kakar was a scholar of religious studies and related fields. He held faculty posts at IIM Ahmedabad (~1968–1971), Harvard University (~1971–1972), and IIT Delhi (~1975–1977).

Sue Hamilton works in Buddhist studies, Indology, and philosophy. She earned her D.Phil. at the University of Oxford under Richard Gombrich and held an academic post at King's College London (attested 2001–2003).
Suk Fun Ng is a scholar of Buddhist studies who earned her PhD at the University of Hong Kong (attested 2014) under the supervision of Jing Yin and Y. Karunadasa.

Sukumar Sen was an Indologist and linguist. He studied at the University of Calcutta (~1921–1925), later held a post there (~1930–1964), and served as Secretary of the Linguistic Society of India (attested 1955).
Sukumari Bhattacharji was an Indologist who studied at the University of Calcutta and Jadavpur University. She taught at Lady Brabourne College (1945) and Jadavpur University (1957–1986).

Sulak Sivaraksa is an author in Buddhist and religious studies who studied at the University of Wales, Lampeter. He held posts with the Social Science Association of Thailand (~1963–1969) and the Siam Society (attested 1992).

Sumanapala Galmangoda is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology who has served as Director of the Postgraduate Institute of Pali and Buddhist Studies and Senior Professor at the University of Kelaniya (attested 2007, 2012).
